SUBSTANTIVE ANALYSIS (Article 343): Declares Hindi in Devanagari script with the international form of Indian numerals as the official language of the Union; provided for the continuation of English for an initial 15-year period, subsequently extended indefinitely by Parliament via the... title: Case 199: Facilities for Instruction in Mother-Tongue at Primary Stage (Article 350A • Service / Regulatory Appeal)
factualMatrix: A constitutional question arose before the Administrative / Statutory Tribunal concerning the scope of Article 350A (Facilities for Instruction in Mother-Tongue at Primary Stage) under Part XVII (Official Language). While the District Collector / Executive Magistrate invoked broad administrative discretion, the petitioner relied on Union of India v. Murasoli Maran (1977) and the principle that Article 350B: Special Officer for Linguistic Minorities appointed by the President., requiring the Bench to determine maintainability, statutory compliance, and appropriate relief.

2. Does the District Collector / Executive Magistrate's executive notification and enforcement order conform to Article 350A (Facilities for Instruction in Mother-Tongue at Primary Stage)?

2. SUBSTANTIVE ANALYSIS (Article 350A): Inserted by the 7th Constitutional Amendment Act 1956: Imposes an affirmative constitutional duty upon every State and local authority to provide adequate facilities for instruction in the mother-tongue at the primary stage of education to children... Applying the governing principle—'Article 350B: Special Officer for Linguistic Minorities appointed by the President.'—the impugned executive notification and enforcement order by the District Collector / Executive Magistrate must strictly satisfy constitutional bounds.
